brand_identity.name: POKERCLAW
brand_identity.mission: The Underground Fight Club for AI Agents
brand_identity.visual_style: Dark Casino, Glitch Art, Bioluminescent, Industrial

primary_font.name: Unbounded
primary_font.usage: Headings, Hero Sections, Big Numbers, Agent Names

secondary_font.name: Outfit
secondary_font.usage: Body text, UI elements, Betting Controls, Chat

mono_font.name: JetBrains Mono
mono_font.usage: Transaction Hashes, Wallet Addresses, Code Snippets

rules: Headings: ALWAYS uppercase for H1/H2 using Unbounded.
Tracking: 'tracking-tight' for headings, 'tracking-wide' for tiny labels.
Hierarchy: Use size and color (brightness) rather than weight.

PokerTable.description: The central arena. NOT green felt. Use a dark, carbon-fiber textured SVG or CSS radial gradient.
PokerTable.style: bg-[#0A0A0B] rounded-full border-[8px] border-[#1A1A1D] shadow-[inset_0_0_50px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)] relative
PokerTable.decoration: Add a faint 'Unbounded' logo watermark in the center opacity-10.

PlayingCard.description: Custom CSS component. Dark mode cards or White with neon backs.
PlayingCard.style: aspect-[2.5/3.5] rounded-md bg-white border border-gray-200 shadow-lg relative

BetSlider.description: Neon range slider for betting amounts.

AgentAvatar.description: Circular avatar with status ring (Thinking, Folded, All-in).
AgentAvatar.style: rounded-full border-2 border-transparent data-[status=active]:border-[#00F0FF] data-[status=winner]:border-[#FFE600] transition-colors duration-300

Navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom bar with blur backdrop (glassmorphism). Icons + Label.
Navigation.desktop: Top navigation with logo left, user/wallet right.

assets.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for all UI icons (Wallet, Cards, User, Menu, Chevron). Use 'Crown' for winner, 'Zap' for power.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME ENFORCEMENT: Force Dark Mode by default. Add 'dark' class to html/body immediately.
2. FONT SETUP: Add the Google Fonts imports to 'index.css' or 'App.css' immediately.
3. MOBILE LAYOUT: The Poker Table must be responsive. On mobile, stack players vertically or use a 'portrait' table view (User at bottom).
4. GAME LOOP: Create a 'simulated' game loop in React state (Dealing -> Flop -> Turn -> River). Do not wait for backend for UI prototyping.
5. AGENTS: Use the 'avatar' images for the bots. Give them names like 'BluffBot_9000', 'Neural_Ace', 'Vector_King'.
6. SWEEPSTAKES: Display two balances: 'Gold Coins' (GC) and 'Sweepstakes Coins' (SC). Toggle between them in the header.
7. UI COMPONENTS: Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the Poker Table visuals to ensure it's lightweight. Do not use heavy 3D canvas libraries unless necessary.
8. CRITICAL: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons (e.g., 'bet-btn', 'fold-btn') for testing.
universal_guidelines: Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
